topics.topic: Behavior of a repeated delivery when an A6 rule 5 refusal applies after a failed placement-record write
questions: If an A6 rule 5 refusal applies when the delivery is repeated, does the repeat refuse with M08 or complete the placement?
Must a repeated delivery complete the placement when an A6 rule 5 refusal applies, or must it return that refusal without completing the placement?
If an A6 rule 5 refusal applies when the delivery is repeated, does the repeat complete the placement or return that refusal without changing the image or records?

quotes:
After condition 5 a stored image may remain without a record: no caller has received
   its reference, and a repeated delivery of the same file writes it again and completes the placement,
   unless a refusal of A6 rule 5 applies.

An image left by a failed record write is completed by a
repeated delivery of the same file.
judgement.why: This is the same question as P1, and neither the relevant passages nor the change since closure altered it.
